newsitem.title: USA: Wis. panel backs $441 mln of construction bonding.
newsitem.headline: Wis. panel backs $441 mln of construction bonding.

text.p: A Wisconsin legislative panel reviewing a capital spending bill for the upcoming fiscal biennium has recommended approving nearly $441 million of bonding authority for construction projects thus far, a fiscal analyst with the state legislative fiscal bureau said.

The legislature's joint finance committee recommendations so far include $350.4 million of general obligation borrowing, $86.3 million of revenue supported borrowing and $4.12 million of segregated funds borrowing, fiscal analyst Al Runde said.

The 16-member committee, made up of senators and representatives, is scheduled to continue its review of the construction spending package on Monday, Runde said. From there, the recommendations need approval of the full legislature and Gov. Tommy Thompson.
The bonding authority plans are part of an overall construction project spending package the committee is reviewing, Runde said.
The joint finance committee in May recommended approval of $12.1 million of general obligation bonds for the state drinking water loan program. The panel also reviews sewer bond requests.
